old_value: {"id":"jmap-chat-spec-66n2","title":"Future: JMAP Photo/Album companion spec","description":"FileNode provides a generic file tree with thumbnails but no photo-specific semantics. A photo library needs: Album type (named collection with ordering and cover image), photo metadata (EXIF, GPS, camera model, date taken), gallery views, shared album permissions, and face/object tagging. Could be a companion spec (draft-atwood-jmap-photo-00) layered on top of FileNode blobs. Not urgent — note for future exploration.","status":"open","priority":4,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"mark@wolfssl.com","created_at":"2026-06-13T06:49:09Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-06-13T06:49:09Z"}
new_value: {"description":"Re-scoped 2026-10-20 (Mark). No standalone photo spec: albums are Graphs (nodes link to FileNodes via uri = jmap:filenode:..., order via sort-key annotation, cover via annotation), sharing via RFC 9670 shareWith, tags as annotations; EXIF reading, gallery UI and face/object detection are implementation. The only interop gap is a shared annotation-key vocabulary so different photo apps agree (cover, order, date taken, location, tags) - i.e. a jmap-graph profile. Blocked on the 'no profiles yet' decision; revisit when profiles are allowed. Open question then: whether servers extract EXIF into annotations for graph-search, or leave it to FileNode metadata upstream.","title":"Future: photo album profile over jmap-graph + FileNode"}
